# Jubileena

Jubileena is a very obscure G4 background Earth pony from *Friendship is Magic*. Think of a mint-haired Cherry Berry with three pairs of cherries on her flank, rather than one. She is not Cherry Jubilee, the ranch owner.

- **Appearance:** Pale peach-orange coat, mint-turquoise mane and tail, lavender eyes, and six red cherries arranged in three pairs. She shares Cherry Berry's character model and eye color.
- **Name and voice:** Jubileena is a fandom catalog name, not a verified official name. Its precise origin is undocumented; her resemblance to G1 Cherries Jubilee suggests a possible inspiration. No dialogue, voice actor, or alternate identity is documented. See the [background mare catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares).
- **Comics:** Also cataloged on page 2 of IDW's *Friendship is Magic* #7 (May 2013), written by Heather Nuhfer, illustrated by Amy Mebberson and colored by Heather Breckel. See the [issue credits and character index](https://comicvine.gamespot.com/my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic-7/4000-402317/). The actual comic panel was not independently verified.

## Important moments

- **Outside the Golden Oak Library — Too Many Pinkie Pies (S3E3):** Her only documented television appearance is a brief shot near the library sign during the Pinkie clone crisis. The catalog places it at 13:37, but the matching timestamp in the [official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fmey5rXdZLU) could not be verified.

No additional character-defining scenes are documented, so a second moment would be speculative.

The [episode screenshot gallery](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Category:Too_Many_Pinkie_Pies_images) indexes the still “Jubileena ID S3E3.png” from the Hasbro/DHX Media production.
